thread:
Alice (PM): Morning — quick triage for Skyhook GA. We're targeting 'prodification' next Wed. Need confirmation on: SLA tiers, docs, support runbook, metrics + alerts, pricing band. Who owns each? :eyes:
Ben (Eng): I can take SLA perf numbers and quantize latency SLO. Need clarification: do we expose 99th percentile per-route? We currently have p50/p95.
Carla (SRE): We can ship alerts for error rate and latency. Suggest p95 target and a safeguard circuit-breaker at 5% error. Also need runbook for throttling.
Derek (Support): I'll own support runbook + escalation matrix. Need sample customer contact and expected response time per tier.
Alice (PM): Good. Pricing question: do we mirror current Hosted tiers or introduce 'skyhook-optimized' discounts? Finance prefers staged rollout. @Ben any cost delta estimates?
Ben (Eng): Preliminary: ~15% token cost reduction with prefix caching. Will run cost sim today; will post numbers in thread.
Carla (SRE): Monitoring: add per-model traffic, per-route latency histograms, kv-cache hit rate. Dashboards in console team, but we need a README for oncall.
Alice (PM): Docs: we need a public "Migration & Limits" page, sample SDK snippet w/ example config, and a "Troubleshooting" section. @Carla can you seed runbook steps for cache warmup?
Carla (SRE): Yup. I'll add steps: warmup job, expected 80% hit after 10 min, commands:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```
Ben (Eng): Also add note about model fallback policy: will fall back to smaller model if OOM; latency impacts documented.
Derek (Support): For SLA, proposed response times: P1 1 hour, P2 24 hours, P3 72 hours. Agree?
Alice (PM): Fine. Legal needs a data processing addendum for early customers — can someone ping legal?
Ben (Eng): @sara-legal pinged.
Alice (PM): Okay owners:
- SLA perf: Ben
- Runbook & alerts: Carla
- Support & escalation: Derek
- Docs: Alice + Ben
- Pricing simulation: Ben + finance
Action: owners to post checklist updates by EOD Fri. If any blockers escalate to #shiproom.
Carla (SRE): One risk: canary infra autoscale limit may cap throughput. Need capacity test on staging by Tue.
Ben (Eng): I'll schedule load test. Sharing link to test plan in 1 hour.
Derek (Support): I'll draft the triage email templates and paste here.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: skyhook/prod -> canary at 2026-03-22T04:00Z
Alice (PM): Thanks, everyone. We'll sync Thurs 9am if anything new.
